stories.text: 🪦 The eulogy is in: Purdy Good gets its send-off (19.40 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 73% / 49%, Ramosverse 19% / 5.8%.
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 75% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 44% with none (now 65%).
🏟️ Game to watch: CAR @ GB (Thursday 8:15 PM), 8 league starters in action with 109.73 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (CAR @ GB): 8 league starters in action. Most riding on it: The Mahomies vs Ruffing the Passer (63.56 pts projected).
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Gibb it to Me Baby has 4 starters on bye this week (Collins, Olave, Likely and Purdy). Hope the bench is ready.
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 44%, with Uriel's Upbeat Team next at 20%.
🤝 Rivalry week: Mr. Action Jackson leads Kyle Tucker 4–3 all-time, and Mr. Action Jackson has won the last 4.
🔥 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy has won 4 straight. Gibb it to Me Baby gets the next crack at them.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 8: Brock You Like a Hurricane 33%, Gibb it to Me Baby 16%, Claremont In Yo Stace! 14%.
📈 Stock rising: Mr. Action Jackson has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
